title: 隧道防水膜鋪設~Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation
focus: 以水壓邊界、焊縫與分區連續性驗證隧道防水膜~Verify tunnel membranes through pressure boundaries, seams and compartment continuity
summary: 本課以以水壓邊界、焊縫與分區連續性驗證隧道防水膜為主線，從水頭與結構承壓邊界與基面平整與膜材跨空建立系統邊界，再把雙焊道試驗與溫度修正、穿透構件與接縫變形連到耐久相容與維護交接。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on verify tunnel membranes through pressure boundaries, seams and compartment continuity. It begins with Head and structural pressure boundary and Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging, links Dual-seam tests and temperature effects and Penetrations and joint movement, and ends with Durability compatibility and handover. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 水頭與結構承壓邊界~Head and structural pressure boundary
units.title: 水頭與結構承壓邊界~Head and structural pressure boundary
units.mechanism: 防水膜本身不會讓地下水壓消失，封閉系統需要襯砌承受相應壓力，排水系統則依可靠排導降低水頭。將排水型和承壓型細部混用會留下不明荷載；必須明確寫出正常、堵塞和維修狀態的水壓邊界。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接；若出現排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A membrane does not eliminate groundwater pressure: a closed system transfers pressure to lining, while a drained system relies on discharge to reduce head. Mixing the two concepts leaves undefined loads. Define pressure boundaries for normal operation, blockage and maintenance states. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare groundwater level, behind-membrane pressure and actual drain connections. If blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 基面平整與膜材跨空~Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging
units.title: 基面平整與膜材跨空~Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging
units.mechanism: 尖突和凹穴使膜材在混凝土擠壓下局部拉伸或刺穿，名義厚度不能補救不相容基面。柔軟墊層分散接觸但也可能壓縮，膜跨越空洞時的拉伸與支承條件不同；基面幾何應在被覆前留下可追溯紀錄。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以輪廓量測與接觸樣板標示尖突、凹穴及墊層位置；若出現膜材被混凝土壓入凹穴而局部拉裂，表面原本看似平順，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Projections and hollows stretch or puncture membrane under concrete pressure; nominal thickness cannot cure an incompatible substrate. Cushioning spreads contact but can compress, while bridging a cavity changes restraint. Record substrate geometry before it is concealed by the membrane. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Map projections, hollows and cushioning using profile measurements and contact templates. If concrete pushes membrane into a hollow and tears it despite a previously smooth appearance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 膜材厚度與批次差異~Membrane thickness and batch differences
units.title: 膜材厚度與批次差異~Membrane thickness and batch differences
units.mechanism: 膜厚是耐穿刺與加工品質的一部分，性能還取決於配方、老化及焊接相容性。局部薄區可能沿捲材邊緣或摺痕出現，平均厚度合格不代表最薄點合格；不同批次材料的接合需證明相容，不能只憑顏色辨認。 判別這個機制時，應觀察分區量測厚度並追溯捲材批號、接縫和摺痕位置；若出現局部薄點在後續施工受壓破裂，平均報告未能預警，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Thickness contributes to puncture resistance and quality, while formulation, ageing and weld compatibility also matter. Thin zones may occur near edges or folds despite a passing mean. Demonstrate compatibility between batches rather than identifying material from colour alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Map thickness by roll batch, seam and fold position. If a locally thin point tears under later construction pressure despite a passing average report, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 焊縫有效寬度與剝離~Effective seam width and peeling
units.title: 焊縫有效寬度與剝離~Effective seam width and peeling
units.mechanism: 焊縫需要連續熔合，外觀寬度不等於有效黏合寬度，污染或皺摺可能形成未熔合通道。剝離與剪切試驗檢查不同受力方式，單一峰值需搭配破壞位置；以完整材料撕裂還是界面分離，會導出不同品質判讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度；若出現表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A seam needs continuous fusion; visible width differs from effective bonded width when contamination or folds create channels. Peel and shear test different loading modes. Interpret peak force together with whether failure tears parent material or separates the interface. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width. If surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 雙焊道試驗與溫度修正~Dual-seam tests and temperature effects
units.title: 雙焊道試驗與溫度修正~Dual-seam tests and temperature effects
units.mechanism: 雙焊道中間的封閉通道可提供連續性檢核，但氣壓隨溫度改變，壓降不全代表漏氣。測試區段端部封閉與儀器接頭也可能洩漏，必須與焊縫本體分開；使用絕對壓力與絕對溫度才能作理想氣體比較。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄通道絕對壓力、溫度及端封接頭檢漏結果；若出現冷卻造成壓降被誤判為焊縫漏氣，引出無效重焊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A closed channel between dual seams tests continuity, but pressure varies with temperature and not every drop is leakage. End closures and instrument fittings can leak separately from the seam. Ideal-gas comparison requires absolute pressure and absolute temperature rather than gauge values alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record absolute channel pressure, temperature and end-fitting leak checks together. If cooling-induced pressure loss is mistaken for a leaking seam and prompts ineffective rewelding, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 分區止水與水路隔離~Compartments and hydraulic isolation
units.title: 分區止水與水路隔離~Compartments and hydraulic isolation
units.mechanism: 分區系統限制漏水在膜後蔓延，水擋、接頭與後續修復管路必須構成連續邊界。圖上分區不等於實體隔離，跨區穿孔或未連接止水帶可讓一處破損影響很大範圍；驗證要追蹤水路而不只是統計隔板數。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口；若出現一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Compartments limit migration behind the membrane through continuous waterstops, joints and repair interfaces. Drawn zones are not physical isolation: penetrations or disconnected stops can spread one defect widely. Verification therefore traces hydraulic paths rather than counting compartment boundaries. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment. If one cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：affectedAreaRatio=oneZone/wholeArea=100 m2/1000 m2=0.10, assuming intact isolation。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: affectedAreaRatio=oneZone/wholeArea=100 m2/1000 m2=0.10, assuming intact isolation. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: One cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~One cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 圖紙畫成多個分區就能保證實際水路隔離~Multiple compartments drawn on a plan guarantee hydraulic isolation in place
units.practice: 將逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 穿透構件與接縫變形~Penetrations and joint movement
units.title: 穿透構件與接縫變形~Penetrations and joint movement
units.mechanism: 支架、預埋件和施工接縫會中斷連續膜面，局部位移常集中在固定點附近。密封細部需要同時容許預期移動並保持水路連續，不能把材料拉伸率直接當作接頭允許位移；自由長度、固定方式及多方向變形都要確認。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形；若出現固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Brackets, embedded items and joints interrupt membrane continuity and concentrate movement near fixings. Details must accommodate movement while preserving water isolation. Material elongation is not the joint movement allowance: free length, restraint and multidirectional deformation require separate verification. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response. If fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：nominalStrain=movement/freeLength=5 mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: nominalStrain=movement/freeLength=5 mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

units.practice: 將比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. units.anchor: 隱蔽前損傷與後續工序~Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work
units.title: 隱蔽前損傷與後續工序~Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work
units.mechanism: 焊縫檢驗後的膜材仍可能被鋼筋、墊塊或台車碰傷，檢查時間因而決定證據有效範圍。修補片會新增邊界與搭接，必須索引到原缺陷位置；最後隱蔽前檢查應覆蓋後續施工造成的損傷，而非重複舊報告。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將膜材照片、修補編號與最後一道交叉工序完成時間連結；若出現檢驗後被鋼筋刺穿，舊合格紀錄無法代表隱蔽時狀態，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Membranes can be damaged by reinforcement, spacers or carriages after seam testing, so inspection timing defines evidence validity. Patches add new boundaries and overlaps and must trace back to defects. Final pre-cover inspection must address damage from subsequent work rather than merely repeat an earlier report. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Link membrane photographs and patch IDs to completion of the final crossing trade. If reinforcement punctures a previously tested membrane and invalidates its earlier passing record, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 漏水定位與表面假象~Leak localization and surface symptoms
units.title: 漏水定位與表面假象~Leak localization and surface symptoms
units.mechanism: 隧道內出水位置未必位於膜材破損處，水可能沿膜後、接縫或空腔移動。只封住可見出口會改變水路，甚至提高局部壓力；診斷需整合分區圖、排水量及時間變化，區分新缺陷、既有連通與排水阻塞。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將出水位置、分區端口反應與水位變化共同繪圖；若出現出口被封後轉移到鄰區，原來的膜破損仍未修復，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~The interior discharge location need not coincide with membrane damage because water migrates behind layers and through joints or cavities. Sealing an outlet redirects paths and may raise local pressure. Combine compartment maps, flow and timing to distinguish new damage, connectivity and blocked drains. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Map discharge, compartment-port responses and groundwater changes together. If a sealed outlet moves to a neighbouring area while the original membrane defect remains, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：leakRate=collectedVolume/time=6 L/20 min=0.30 L/min。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: leakRate=collectedVolume/time=6 L/20 min=0.30 L/min. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A sealed outlet moves to a neighbouring area while the original membrane defect remains. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to map discharge, compartment-port responses and groundwater changes together to discriminate the cause. units.anchor: 耐久相容與維護交接~Durability compatibility and handover
units.title: 耐久相容與維護交接~Durability compatibility and handover
units.mechanism: 防水膜與修補材料的相容性可能受塑化劑、溫度和地下水化學影響，短期黏著良好不能保證長期功能。交接應保存原材料、焊接及分區資料，讓未來修繕能確認材料搭配；未知材料直接覆貼可能使原系統更難診斷。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷；若出現失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Compatibility with repair materials can depend on plasticizers, temperature and groundwater chemistry; initial adhesion does not establish durability. Retain material, welding and compartment records for future selection. Overlaying unknown materials can make the original system harder to diagnose and maintain. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit batches, compatibility evidence, compartment maps and patch histories. If lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查水頭與結構承壓邊界：p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa；再獨立檢查基面平整與膜材跨空：localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。水頭由 20 增為 30 m 時，淡水壓力由 196.2 增為 294.3 kPa；膜後排水堵塞的水頭須與結構模型一致。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 將將膜材照片、修補編號與最後一道交叉工序完成時間連結作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Head and structural pressure boundary: p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa. Independently check Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging: localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent. Raising freshwater head from 20 to 30 m increases pressure from 196.2 to 294.3 kPa; a blocked-drain head must agree with the structural model. The two results are not a complete design because the membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. Use link membrane photographs and patch ids to completion of the final crossing trade as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的以水壓邊界、焊縫與分區連續性驗證隧道防水膜，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on verify tunnel membranes through pressure boundaries, seams and compartment continuity reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
